1.name: Bandit

effects.text: When played, blocks 1 card with {coin} production.
Spend {sword} to defeat ({destroy}) and gain any 2 resources.

defeat.text: Spend {sword} to defeat ({destroy}) and gain any 2 resources.

1.text: {triggeredForced} When played, blocks 1 card with {coin} production. {activated} Spend {sword} to defeat ({destroy}) and gain any 2 resources. (Can be {flip} by a Missionary)
1.helpText:
When this card is played, you must choose one of your friendly cards in play that produces gold, if possible, and the Bandit blocks that card. If there is no such card, the effect is ignored, even if another card later comes into play which produces gold.
This effect may also target cards played together with the Bandit, since cards are first played, then performed.
You may spend a sword to destroy the Bandit and gain any 2 resources. You may use the effect on a Missionary to convert him, turning him to the other side.

4.name: Field Worker

effects.text: Choose a land in play. Gain its production as resources.

4.text: {activated} Choose a land in play. Gain its production as resources.
4.helpText: You may discard this card to gain the resources that a land (green banner) in play can produce. This doesn't discard that land. This does not include resources that that land can gain through Activated Effects, only the actual production. However, if an effect says that the land produces more resources, those are also gained when using this card.

description:
VERSION NOTE: A skull icon in the keyword banner means the card is a negative card.
This card starts as a Bandit. Either you kill the bandit and gain some resources, or you use a Missionary to convert him into a Field Worker.
